hits.sourceExample: Good leaders have both a conscience and a backbone.
hits.learnerText: A shop supervisor found that a cake label left out a nut ingredient. Even though the weekend sale was busy, she stopped the sale and corrected the label. Her decision showed she had both a conscience and a backbone.
